connector.name: Myvideogift
connector.registryDescription: Create and deliver personalized video gifts (photos + an original song) from any agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package myvideogift-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cryptolibertus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MVG_API_KEY
env.description: A My Video Gift prepaid-credit API key (mvg_live_...) from https://developers.myvideogift.com

env.name: MVG_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://myvideogift.com/api/v1).
